title: 09-25 upload FZ-E
description: The 09-24 package plus: a wider grid for the per-trajectory energy-blend choice, a per-trajectory blend-ridge choice, CB weight 1.0 on window 0 (together called AXE), the regime-change reset (REC), and the IPC, KD4 and KD5 execution changes. Energy net: one net fitted on the 3-member ensemble (the 4-seed energy net came on 09-26).

approximates.label: 53f7865c (retrain of FZ-E e71e0cbf on a second machine, Codabench 944304)

training.note: differs from the final weights only in ke_net_flow.pt; KE3=0 on the default flags builds the same weight dir

fidelity.why: Each component switched off here was checked bit-exact against the package before it when it was added (independent verification runs; development notes, not published). With the final weights the energy net is the 4-seed one, not this upload's.
